name: 黃天偉
objective: This course provides a systematic study of the legal framework and professional practice of mergers and acquisitions (M&A). It examines the role of M&A in corporate growth, transaction structures and procedures, directors’ duties, hostile takeovers, takeover defenses, corporate control, tender offers, cross-border transactions, and post-acquisition issues.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1 — Introduction
Week 2 — Ch 1 M & A: A Key Driver of Corporate Growth（併購：企業成長的關鍵）
Week 3 — Ch 2 Introduction to Corporate M & A（企業併購簡介）
Week 4 — Ch 3 Directors’ Duties and Procedures in Corporate M & A（企業併購下董事之責任及程序）
Week 5 — Ch 4 Legal Issues in Hostile Takeovers（敵意併購相關議題探討）
Week 6 — Ch 5 Defenses Against Hostile Takeovers: The Tatung Corporate Control Contest（敵意併購的防禦措施──以大同經營權爭奪為例）
Week 7 — Case 1 BenQ’s Acquisition of Siemens’ Mobile Devices Business（明基併購西門子手機部門案）
Week 8 — Case 2 Jabil’s Acquisition of Green Point Enterprises（捷普併購綠點案）
Week 9 — Case 3 Lungyen’s Backdoor Listing Through Dahan Development（龍巖借殼大漢上市案）
Week 10 — Case 4 Colorful Group’s Indirect Acquisition of Chaintech Technology（七彩虹間接入主承啟科技案）
Week 11 — Case 5 ASE’s Acquisition of SPIL（日月光併購矽品案）
Week 12 — Case 6 Foxconn’s Acquisition of Sharp（鴻海夏普併購案）
Week 13 — Case 7 Bai Chi Gan Tou’s Tender Offer for XPEC Entertainment（百尺竿頭公開收購樂陞案）
Week 14 — Case 8 ASML’s Acquisition of Hermes Microvision（ASML 併購漢微科案）
Week 15 — Case 9 Alibaba’s Acquisition of Sun Art Retail（阿里巴巴併購高鑫案）
Week 16 — Case 10 KKR’s Acquisition of LCY Chemical（KKR 併購榮化案）

延伸教學與資源: ● 混成學習 (Blended Learning) 課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG8：尊嚴就業與經濟發展（Decent Work and Economic Growth）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）SDG16：和平正義與有力的制度（Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）● 深入探討 AI 的原理與應用（Explore the principles and applications of AI in depth）
